card.name: Recurring intervals: every, monthly, weekly
card.fires_on: The word "every" (or a nearby word like once, weekly, monthly, or the unit after "every seven") when it introduces how often something repeats. It appears in monitoring schedules and in descriptions of recurring events.

modes.label: Monitoring schedules
modes.description: "every" after a test or monitoring item, giving how often to repeat it.
modes.example: HbA1c<< every>> 3 months and as clinically indicated.

modes.label: Recurring events
modes.description: Frequency words in general text about events that repeat over years or cycles.
modes.example: Since 1349 it is carried out every seven<< years>>.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about cycles and regular repetition, such as cycle, periodic, and "every" in Chinese.
card.plain: It lights up on words that say something repeats at regular intervals, like "every 3 months" or "weekly".
